# lol.trq.helios

> A rendering library for Minecraft Forge 1.8.9 on modern OpenGL: SDF shapes, MSDF text, blur, bloom, clipping,
> 3D meshes and player-model anchors. OpenGL 4.1 core profile only (the Lazarus core renderer), GLSL 410 core, Java 17 bytecode, no Mixin, MIT.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): requirements, packages, usage, harness
- [OpenGL rules](docs/opengl.md): core 4.1 requirement, shader dialect, drawing and state rules, macOS limits
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): mental model, patterns that matter, traps
- [CHANGELOG](CHANGELOG.md): release notes
- [CONTRIBUTING](CONTRIBUTING.md): commit and test conventions
- [BENCHMARKS](BENCHMARKS.md): CPU and GPU numbers, how to run them
- [NOTICE](NOTICE.md): msdfgen port and the Inter font

## Core source

- [Helios](helios/src/main/java/lol/trq/helios/Helios.java): entry point, one per GL context
- [GlBackend](helios/src/main/java/lol/trq/helios/gl/GlBackend.java): the GL seam
- [Gl41CoreBackend](helios/src/main/java/lol/trq/helios/gl/Gl41CoreBackend.java): OpenGL 4.1 core backend, context check
- [StreamBuffer](helios/src/main/java/lol/trq/helios/gl/StreamBuffer.java): per-frame vertex upload ring with fences
- [StateGuard](helios/src/main/java/lol/trq/helios/state/StateGuard.java): save on first touch, restore on close
- [GlStateCache](helios/src/main/java/lol/trq/helios/state/GlStateCache.java): host state cache seam
- [ShaderPreprocessor](helios/src/main/java/lol/trq/helios/shader/ShaderPreprocessor.java): includes, defines, #line
- [ShaderLoader](helios/src/main/java/lol/trq/helios/shader/ShaderLoader.java): compile, link, reload
- [ShaderProgram](helios/src/main/java/lol/trq/helios/shader/ShaderProgram.java): uniform location cache
- [ShaderLog](helios/src/main/java/lol/trq/helios/shader/ShaderLog.java): driver logs to file:line
- [FramebufferPool](helios/src/main/java/lol/trq/helios/fbo/FramebufferPool.java): framebuffer reuse, resize handling
- [Sdf](helios/src/main/java/lol/trq/helios/sdf/Sdf.java) and [sdf.glsl](helios/src/main/resources/lol/trq/helios/shaders/lib/sdf.glsl): distance and coverage
- [ShapeBatch](helios/src/main/java/lol/trq/helios/batch/ShapeBatch.java) and [shape.fsh](helios/src/main/resources/lol/trq/helios/shaders/shape.fsh): batched primitives
- [Paint](helios/src/main/java/lol/trq/helios/batch/Paint.java): solid, corner, linear and radial colour
- [Passes](helios/src/main/java/lol/trq/helios/effect/Passes.java): capture, dual Kawase blur, composite, custom passes
- [Effects](helios/src/main/java/lol/trq/helios/effect/Effects.java): blur behind a shape, bloom
- [PostChain](helios/src/main/java/lol/trq/helios/effect/PostChain.java): chained full-screen passes
- [ScissorStack](helios/src/main/java/lol/trq/helios/state/ScissorStack.java): nested clipping
- [StencilMask](helios/src/main/java/lol/trq/helios/state/StencilMask.java): clip to any shape
- [MsdfFont](helios/src/main/java/lol/trq/helios/text/MsdfFont.java): .hfnt font loading, glyphs, kerning, atlas
- [TextRenderer](helios/src/main/java/lol/trq/helios/text/TextRenderer.java) and [TextStyle](helios/src/main/java/lol/trq/helios/text/TextStyle.java): layout, codes, shadows
- [ShaderHotReload](helios/src/main/java/lol/trq/helios/shader/ShaderHotReload.java): development hot reload
- [Colors](helios/src/main/java/lol/trq/helios/color/Colors.java): packed colour maths
- [Easing](helios/src/main/java/lol/trq/helios/anim/Easing.java), [Animation](helios/src/main/java/lol/trq/helios/anim/Animation.java), [Smooth](helios/src/main/java/lol/trq/helios/anim/Smooth.java), [Stopwatch](helios/src/main/java/lol/trq/helios/anim/Stopwatch.java): timing and animation
- [Maths](helios/src/main/java/lol/trq/helios/math/Maths.java), [Mat4](helios/src/main/java/lol/trq/helios/math/Mat4.java), [Projector](helios/src/main/java/lol/trq/helios/math/Projector.java): numbers, matrices, world to screen
- [MinecraftWorld](helios/src/main/java/lol/trq/helios/minecraft/MinecraftWorld.java): partial ticks, camera, interpolated entity positions
- [MeshRenderer](helios/src/main/java/lol/trq/helios/mesh/MeshRenderer.java): 3D quads, AA lines, textured lit quads
- [QuadSink](helios/src/main/java/lol/trq/helios/mesh/QuadSink.java), [LineSink](helios/src/main/java/lol/trq/helios/mesh/LineSink.java), [TexturedSink](helios/src/main/java/lol/trq/helios/mesh/TexturedSink.java): the vertex sinks
- [MeshRecorder](helios/src/main/java/lol/trq/helios/mesh/MeshRecorder.java) and [StaticMesh](helios/src/main/java/lol/trq/helios/mesh/StaticMesh.java): meshes uploaded once
- [PlayerModel](helios/src/main/java/lol/trq/helios/model/PlayerModel.java), [PlayerPose](helios/src/main/java/lol/trq/helios/model/PlayerPose.java), [Attachment](helios/src/main/java/lol/trq/helios/model/Attachment.java): player-model anchors
- [MinecraftOptiFine](helios/src/main/java/lol/trq/helios/minecraft/MinecraftOptiFine.java): OptiFine presence, version, Fast Render
- [MinecraftPlayerPose](helios/src/main/java/lol/trq/helios/minecraft/MinecraftPlayerPose.java): a live player's pose for the frame
- [AtlasBuilder](fontgen/src/main/java/lol/trq/helios/fontgen/AtlasBuilder.java) and [FontGen](fontgen/src/main/java/lol/trq/helios/fontgen/FontGen.java): atlas building and its command line
- [MsdfGenerator](fontgen/src/main/java/lol/trq/helios/fontgen/MsdfGenerator.java), [EdgeColoring](fontgen/src/main/java/lol/trq/helios/fontgen/EdgeColoring.java), [EdgeSegment](fontgen/src/main/java/lol/trq/helios/fontgen/EdgeSegment.java): the msdfgen port
- [MinecraftHelios](helios/src/main/java/lol/trq/helios/minecraft/MinecraftHelios.java) and [MinecraftGlStateCache](helios/src/main/java/lol/trq/helios/minecraft/MinecraftGlStateCache.java): the Minecraft hook

## Examples

- [StateGuardTest](helios/src/test/java/lol/trq/helios/state/StateGuardTest.java): guard semantics
- [ShaderPreprocessorTest](helios/src/test/java/lol/trq/helios/shader/ShaderPreprocessorTest.java): include and define rules
- [ShaderLoaderTest](helios/src/test/java/lol/trq/helios/shader/ShaderLoaderTest.java): errors, uniform cache, reload
- [FramebufferPoolTest](helios/src/test/java/lol/trq/helios/fbo/FramebufferPoolTest.java): pooling and resize
- [SdfTest](helios/src/test/java/lol/trq/helios/sdf/SdfTest.java): distance and coverage math
- [ShapeBatchTest](helios/src/test/java/lol/trq/helios/batch/ShapeBatchTest.java): vertex layout, batching, flushes
- [EffectsTest](helios/src/test/java/lol/trq/helios/effect/EffectsTest.java): blur levels, bloom, post chain
- [ScissorStackTest](helios/src/test/java/lol/trq/helios/state/ScissorStackTest.java): clip conversion and nesting
- [TextTest](helios/src/test/java/lol/trq/helios/text/TextTest.java): font loading, widths, kerning, codes, shadows
- [StencilMaskTest](helios/src/test/java/lol/trq/helios/state/StencilMaskTest.java): mask and content state
- [ShaderHotReloadTest](helios/src/test/java/lol/trq/helios/shader/ShaderHotReloadTest.java): change detection, failed reloads
- [FontGenTest](fontgen/src/test/java/lol/trq/helios/fontgen/FontGenTest.java): distances, colouring, glyphs against the rasterizer
- [ColorsTest](helios/src/test/java/lol/trq/helios/color/ColorsTest.java), [AnimTest](helios/src/test/java/lol/trq/helios/anim/AnimTest.java), [MathTest](helios/src/test/java/lol/trq/helios/math/MathTest.java): colour, animation, matrices and projection
- [WorldCheck](harness-mod/src/main/java/lol/trq/helios/harness/mod/WorldCheck.java): projection against the real camera
- [HeliosBench](helios/src/jmh/java/lol/trq/helios/bench/HeliosBench.java): CPU benchmarks
- [HarnessMod](harness-mod/src/main/java/lol/trq/helios/harness/mod/HarnessMod.java) and [Checks](harness-mod/src/main/java/lol/trq/helios/harness/mod/Checks.java): in-game use and checks; [Model](harness-mod/src/main/java/lol/trq/helios/harness/mod/Model.java): software model of the shape shader

## Optional

- [Harness launcher](harness/src/main/java/lol/trq/helios/harness/DevLaunch.java): downloads and boots the game
